name: mac-organizer
description: iCloud Photos Organizer — native macOS app to review Photos albums and export them to a folder
author: teziovsky

scripts.clean: rm -rf build dist && xcodebuild -project MacOrganizer.xcodeproj -scheme MacOrganizer -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData clean
scripts.build: xcodebuild -project MacOrganizer.xcodeproj -scheme MacOrganizer -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
scripts.clean:build: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.build:production: xcodebuild -project MacOrganizer.xcodeproj -scheme MacOrganizer -configuration Release -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
scripts.release: npm run build:production && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && ditto build/DerivedData/Build/Products/Release/MacOrganizer.app dist/MacOrganizer.app && ditto -c -k --sequesterRsrc --keepParent dist/MacOrganizer.app dist/MacOrganizer-macOS.zip && echo 'Release artifacts: dist/MacOrganizer.app dist/MacOrganizer-macOS.zip'
